name: answering-service-care
description: Your Answering Service Care messages, follow-up To Dos, on-call schedules and how contacts are reached, with your own Client Portal login.

interface.longDescription:
Answering Service Care answers calls for your business around the clock. This plugin lets ChatGPT work with your Answering Service Care account, so you can ask about your service the way you'd ask a colleague.

What you can do:
- See the messages that need attention, urgent ones first, and add a note after you follow up.
- Review your follow-up To Dos.
- Ask who's on call tonight, including backups, in your line's own time zone, and spot gaps in coverage.
- Add or change on-call shifts, and update how each contact receives messages.

How it works:
- You sign in with your own Client Portal login. ChatGPT sees only the accounts that login can see.
- ChatGPT asks for your approval before every change and shows exactly what it will change.
- Changing the on-call schedule needs Calendar Management access on the account.

Messages can include personal details your callers share. Review ChatGPT's answers before you act on them. You can disconnect at any time in ChatGPT's settings.
defaultPrompt: Show me the messages I need to follow up on today.
Who is on call for my line tonight?
Which To Dos are still open on my account?

positive.description: Messages and To Dos that need attention
positive.prompt: What needs my attention today? Include messages and To Dos.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's unacknowledged messages with urgent ones first, then its open To Dos. Nothing is opened, acknowledged or changed.

positive.prompt: Who's on call tonight, including backups?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the person covering each escalation level tonight, with shift times in the line's own time zone, and points out any level with nobody scheduled. Read-only.

positive.prompt: Are we covered this weekend? Any gaps?
positive.expected_behavior: Checks every escalation level for Saturday and Sunday, lists hours with nobody on shift and anyone on shift with no way to reach them, and states the period and time zone it checked. Read-only.

positive.description: Add a note to a message
positive.prompt: Add a note to my latest urgent message saying I called the caller back.
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies the message, shows the exact message and note text, and waits for approval. After approval it saves the note, reads it back, and leaves the message's status unchanged.

positive.description: Change how an on-call contact is reached
positive.prompt: Change the text number for one of my on-call contacts to (555) 010-0199.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks which contact if more than one could match, shows the current and new number and which lines are affected, and waits for approval before updating. Confirms the saved number afterwards.

negative.description: A company the login doesn't belong to. The plugin should find only the test login's own accounts, say it has no access to that company, and show nothing from any other account.
negative.prompt: Show me the messages for Northwind Plumbing.

negative.description: Card details in chat. The plugin should not take payment details and should point to the Client Portal instead.
negative.prompt: Here's my card, 4242 4242 4242 4242. Pay my balance.

negative.description: Deleting an escalation level. Client logins can't delete escalation levels, so the server refuses, nothing changes, and the plugin explains why.
negative.prompt: Delete the backup escalation level on my line.

review.commerce_description: This plugin doesn't sell products or take payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: review messages and add notes, review follow-up To Dos, check and change on-call coverage, and update how on-call contacts are reached, all with your own Client Portal login.
